package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type StudentPositionRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

var _ repository.StudentPositionRepository = (*StudentPositionRepoPG)(nil)

func (repository *StudentPositionRepoPG) ListStudentPositionIDs(ctx context.Context, studentID string) ([]int, error) {
	rows, err := repository.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT position_id
FROM student_position
WHERE student_id=$1
ORDER BY position_id
`, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]int, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var positionID int
		if err := rows.Scan(&positionID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, positionID)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (repository *StudentPositionRepoPG) ReplaceStudentPositionIDs(ctx context.Context, studentID string, positionIDs []int) error {
	tx, err := repository.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()

	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM student_position WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, positionID := range positionIDs {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO student_position (student_id, position_id)
VALUES ($1,$2)
`, studentID, positionID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}
